property_summary: Only the product's coordinator owner may successfully change maintenance(): on P every non-owner call to updateMaintenance reverts (leaving maintenance() untouched), while the mutant inverts the check so a non-owner call completes and stores the new value, breaking the rule 'any non-owner caller must be reverted'.
change_summary: Invert the authorization check so non-owners can perform the update (changing the stored value) while owners revert.
